raw_text:
Here’s the complete 12-week prenatal strength plan summary, integrating the upgraded Phase 2 intensity, pressing emphasis, cardio, core, and nutrition. Client: 30, advanced lifter, 20 weeks pregnant, OB-cleared for moderate strength. Guardrails: no supine after week 16, no max attempts, no contact sports, avoid Valsalva, stop with coning/doming, pelvic heaviness, dizziness, pain; autoregulate via RPE and symptoms.

Global structure
- Frequency: 3 strength days/week (A/B/C) + 2–3 cardio sessions + 3 core mini-blocks (10–15 min). Optional short Day D for pressing.
- RPE: Mostly 6–7; Phase 2 peaks at 7–7.5 on select sets with pristine form. Leave 1–3 reps in reserve.
- Session length: 50–75 minutes including warm-up/cool-down.
- Movement priorities: Squat/hinge, unilateral lower, horizontal/vertical push-pull, carries. Use safety bar, trap bar, incline presses, machines/cables as needed.
- Positioning: No flat supine; use 30–60° incline, side-lying, quadruped, tall/half-kneeling, standing. Wider stances and reduced ROM as bump grows.
- Breathing: 360 inhale; exhale on exertion; gentle pelvic floor assist on exhale; fully relax between reps.

Warm-up (10–12 minutes, all sessions)
- 2–3 minutes easy cyclical (walk/bike)
- Mobility/activation: cat-cow to neutral, thread-the-needle, half-kneeling hip flexor + reach, supported deep squat pry, band pull-aparts
- Core-breathing primer: 90/90 or side-lying rib expansion x 5 breaths; incline dead bug arms/heel slides 2x6–8 or bird dog 2x6–8

Cool-down (5–8 minutes)
- Easy walk/bike 2–3 minutes; gentle hip/pec/lat/calves stretches; 5 cycles 360 breathing side-lying

Phase 1 (Weeks 1–3): Base and recalibration (moderate volume, RPE 6–7)
- Goal: Maintain strength/muscle, groove breathing/bracing, establish bump-safe setups.

Week 1
- Day A (Lower + push): Safety bar squat 4x6; DB incline press 4x8; DB RDL 3x8; half-kneeling chop 3x10/side; face pulls 3x12–15; sled push 4x20 m
- Day B (Hinge + upper): Trap bar deadlift 4x5; chest-supported row 4x8; half-kneeling landmine press 3x8/side; lat pulldown 3x10; hip abduction 3x12/side; farmer carry 4x30–40 m
- Day C (Full-body + unilateral): Front/goblet squat 4x6–8; RDL 3x8; 1-arm cable row 3x10/side; Pallof press 3x12/side; reverse lunge 3x8/side; 8–10 min easy bike
- Upper press add-on (end of Day B or short Day D): DB incline bench 4x8–10; cable fly 3x12–15; landmine press 3x8/side; elevated push-up 3x8–12; triceps rope 3x12–15
- Cardio: 2 sessions (25 min walk; 20–25 min bike @ RPE 4–5)
- Core (3x/week, 10–15 min): Incline dead bug, bird dog, tall-kneeling Pallof, side plank (knees), carries

Week 2
- Small progression (+2.5–5% or +1 rep if last week ≤RPE 6)
- Keep structure; add volume slightly across main/accessories
- Cardio: 3 sessions (walk 25–30 min; elliptical 20–25 min; swim 20 min easy/intervals)
- Core: Progress reps/holds slightly

Week 3
- Slight volume bump or load if moving well
- Cardio: 3 sessions (walk 30; bike 25 with 4 x 60 s pickups @ RPE 6; row 20 easy if comfortable)
- Core: Add one extra set to a movement

Phase 2 (Weeks 4–6): Strength emphasis with higher intent (RPE 7–7.5, density, clusters)
- Goal: Keep training “feel” high while safe; no grinders, no breath holds.

Week 4
- Day A: Safety bar squat 5x3 @ RPE 7 + cluster back-offs 2x(2+2); DB incline press 4x6 @ RPE 7 + 1xAMRAP-1; Trap bar RDL 4x6; seated row 4x8; 8–10 min sled/walk/face-pull circuit
- Day B: Trap bar deadlift 6x2 @ RPE 7 then EMOM 6 x 1 @ ~85% of day’s double; landmine press 4x6/side; chest-supported row 4x8–10; pulldown 3x6–8; split squat 3x8/side; suitcase carry 4x30–35 m/side
- Day C: Box squat 5x3 @ RPE 7 + tempo 1x5; single-leg RDL 4x6/side; incline machine press 4x6–8; 1-arm high cable row 3x10/side; Pallof holds 3x10/side; bike 8 min 30/60s
- Bench-focus add-on (optional Day D or sub into C): Barbell incline bench 5x5 @ RPE 7 + 1xAMRAP-2; landmine press 4x6/side; fly 3x12; machine press 3x8; triceps 2–3x12–15
- Cardio: 3 sessions (walk 30; bike 25–30 with 5 x 60 s @ RPE 6; swim 25)
- Core: 2 circuits this week (Pallof step-out; half-kneeling anti-rotation; tall-kneeling chop; side plank; offset carry)

Week 5
- Day A: Safety bar squat 7x2 @ RPE 7 + 6-min density EMOM 2s; DB incline 5x5 @ RPE 7 + 1xAMRAP-2; Trap bar RDL 4x5 (pause); seated row 4x8–10; sled push 6x25 m
- Day B: Trap bar deadlift 5x3 @ RPE 7 + cluster 2x(2+2); landmine press 5x5/side; chest-supported row 4x8; pulldown 4x6; RFESS 3x6–8/side; suitcase+farmer combo 3 rounds
- Day C: Box squat EMOM 8 x 2 @ RPE 6.5–7; single-leg RDL 4x6/side; incline press 4x6–8; cable row 3x10–12/side; Pallof to overhead raise 3x8–10/side; bike/elliptical 10 min 40/50s
- Bench-focus: Barbell incline 6x4 @ RPE 7 + clusters; fly 3x12; pressdown 3x15
- Cardio: 3–4 sessions (incline walk with 6 x 45 s brisk; steady bike; optional 20 min recovery walk)
- Core: 3 circuits; add marching suitcase or offset front-rack carry

Week 6 (deload-light, still engaged)
- Day A: Safety bar squat 4x3 @ RPE 6–6.5; DB incline 3x6; Trap bar RDL 3x6; seated row 3x8; sled 4x20 m
- Day B: Trap bar deadlift 4x2 @ RPE 6–6.5; landmine 3x6/side; chest-supported row 3x8; pulldown 2–3x8; split squat 2x6/side; suitcase carry 3x25 m/side
- Day C: Box squat EMOM 6 x 2 @ RPE 6; single-leg RDL 2–3x6/side; incline press 2–3x8; 1-arm row 2–3x10/side; easy bike 6–8 min
- Bench-focus: Barbell incline 4x4 @ RPE 6–6.5 + light accessories 2x12
- Cardio: 2–3 easy sessions (walk 25–30; swim/bike 20–25)
- Core: 2 circuits, RPE 5–6; favor carries and Pallof holds

Phase 3 (Weeks 7–9): Stability/unilateral bias, tempo/pauses (RPE 6–7)
- Goal: Maintain strength, prioritize comfort and pelvic control.

Week 7
- Day A: Safety bar squat tempo 2-sec eccentric 4x5; DB incline press 4x8; DB RDL pause 3x6; 1-arm cable row 3x10/side; half-kneeling lift 3x10/side; sled/walk 10–12 min
- Day B: Trap bar deadlift 4x3 @ RPE 6; landmine press 4x6–8/side; single-arm pulldown 3x10/side; RFESS (reduced ROM) 3x6–8/side; face pull+ER 3x12–15; farmer carry 4x30 m
- Day C: Goblet box squat 4x6–8; single-leg RDL 3x6–8/side; side-lying Pallof 3x10–12/side; chest-supported row 3x10; low cable fly 2–3x12; easy cardio 12–15 min
- Cardio: 3 sessions (recumbent bike 30; walk with 6 x 60 s brisk; swim 25–30)
- Core: 2–3 moves/session, 2–3 sets (Pallof ISO, chops/lifts, side planks, supported hip airplanes, backward sled drags)

Week 8
- Small progression in reps/load if RPE ≤6 last week; similar structure as Week 7
- Cardio: Elliptical 30; walk 30 steady; bike 25 with 6 x 45 s @ RPE 6
- Core: Progress holds by ~5 s; slight band increase

Week 9 (micro-deload)
- Day A: Safety bar squat 3–4x5 @ RPE 6; swap hinge to cable pull-through 3x10–12; 1-arm row 3x10/side
- Day B: Trap bar deadlift 3x3 @ RPE 5–6; landmine press 3x6/side; split squat 2–3x6/side
- Day C: Goblet box squat 3x6–7; single-leg RDL 2–3x6/side; Pallof 2–3x12/side
- Cardio: 2–3 easy sessions (walk 25–30; swim 20–25; light bike)
- Core: Maintain, lower RPE

Phase 4 (Weeks 10–12): Quality and comfort into early third trimester (RPE 5–6 most, brief 6–6.5 touches)
- Goal: Keep strength touchpoints, adjust ROM/stance, more machines/cables, prioritize recovery.

Week 10
- Day A: Safety bar box squat 4x4–5; incline DB press 4x6–8; DB RDL or pull-through 3x8; seated row 3x10; standing Pallof 3x12/side; sled/walk 10–12
- Day B: Trap bar deadlift 4x2–3; landmine press 3x6–8/side; pulldown 3x8–10; step-up (low) 3x8/side; face pulls 3x15; suitcase carry 3x25–30 m/side
- Day C: Goblet squat to box 4x6–8; single-leg RDL light 3x6/side; clams/monster walks 3x12–15; chest-supported row 3x10; incline machine press 2–3x10; easy cardio 10–15
- Cardio: 3 sessions (recumbent bike 25–30; walk with 4–6 x 45 s brisk; pool 25–30)
- Core: 2–3 moves/session, 2 sets (Pallof ISO or anti-extension pulldown; side-lying clam; offset carry)

Week 11
- Maintain or small progression if feeling great; otherwise hold loads
- Same structure as Week 10 with tiny tweaks; keep RPE 6
- Cardio: 2–3 sessions (elliptical 25–30; steady walk 25–30; optional easy bike)
- Core: 2–3 moves/session, 2 sets

Week 12 (taper + safe “peak-like” assessments; no 1RM testing)
- Day A: Safety bar box squat assessment EMOM 8–10 x 1 @ RPE 6–7 (best smooth single), light accessories
- Day B: Trap bar deadlift top triple @ RPE 6.5–7 + 2x3 back-offs @ -5–7%; landmine press EMOM 6 x 2/side @ RPE 6–6.5
- Day C: Incline press assessment: work to top 3–5 @ RPE 7, then AMRAP-3; easy rows/carries
- Reduce total volume 20–30%; intensity “feel” via speed/intent, not max load
- Cardio: 2 easy sessions (walk 20–25; swim/bike 20–25)
- Core: Short, light session (Pallof ISO 2x20 s/side; offset carry 2x20–25 m/side)

Core plan (ongoing highlights)
- 3 mini-blocks/week, 10–15 min: anti-extension (band pulldown, elevated bear if no doming), anti-rotation (Pallof presses/ISOs, chops/lifts), frontal plane (side planks/clams), carries (suitcase/offset front-rack). Progress time under tension and light resistance; regress at first sign of doming/heaviness.

Cardio plan (ongoing highlights)
- 2–4 sessions/week, 20–35 min, RPE 4–6; low-impact modalities: incline walk, bike (upright/recumbent), elliptical, swim. Phase 2 includes gentle intervals (RPE ≤6.5–7). Hydrate 300–500 mL per 30 minutes; avoid heat/overheating.

Nutrition for pregnancy and lean mass
- Calories: +250–300 kcal/day in 2nd trimester; consider +350–450 if entering 3rd and weight gain below target. Adjust ±100–200 kcal based on weekly weight trend, energy, OB targets.
- Protein: 1.6–2.0 g/kg/day (pre-pregnancy BW), 4–5 meals (25–40 g/meal).
- Carbs: 3–5 g/kg/day; center around training; choose mostly low–moderate GI carbs.
- Fats: 0.8–1.0 g/kg/day; emphasize unsaturated; include DHA.
- Timing: Pre 60–120 min: 20–30 g protein + 30–60 g carbs; post 1–2 h: 25–35 g protein + 60–90 g carbs.
- Hydration/electrolytes: 2.3–2.7 L/day baseline + 300–500 mL around sessions; electrolytes if sweating.
- Key micronutrients (with OB): prenatal (folate/iodine/iron), iron 27 mg/day total, calcium 1,000 mg/day, choline 450 mg/day, vitamin D per labs, DHA 200–300 mg/day.
- Food safety: no unpasteurized items; low-mercury fish; heat deli meats; cook eggs/fish thoroughly.
- Optional supplements with OB approval: magnesium glycinate 200–300 mg; creatine 3–5 g/day only if approved.

Safety and coaching cues
- Exhale through the sticking point; no Valsalva.
- Stack ribs over pelvis; adjust stance/ROM to comfort; use safety bar, trap bar, cables/machines as needed.
- Monitor and modify with any pain, coning/doming, pelvic heaviness, dizziness, bleeding, fluid leakage, contractions, or decreased fetal movement—consult OB.
